**Finding: Compliant — no audit right binds us.**

The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification provision of any kind, and no right for Kubient to access Customer systems. The only "access" obligation on The Associated Press (§1, p0001) is an ordinary cooperation covenant to enable service delivery, and the revenue-share/payment mechanics in §5 (p0023) grant Kubient no verification right. Since silence is better for us than the playbook's preferred position, no redline is proposed — but if Kubient raises an audit clause in negotiation, we should hold it to once per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Kubient's cost absent underpayment above 5%, and no direct system access.
